---
name: Format change / 格式变化
about: Report a Codex session format change / 报告 Codex 会话格式变化
---

## English

Please avoid pasting real session content, paths, usernames, email addresses, or secrets.
When using `tlineage doctor --json`, share only aggregate fields. See the [contributing guide](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).
Report vulnerabilities privately through the repository’s Security tab.

Please include the Codex version, record types, aggregate counts, and a synthetic reproduction. Follow the sanitize-fixture workflow in the contributing guide and review the fixture manually before sharing.

## 中文

请勿粘贴真实会话内容、真实路径、用户名、邮箱或密钥。
使用 tlineage doctor --json 时仅摘录聚合字段，参考 [贡献指南](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)。
漏洞请通过仓库 Security 页签私密报告。

请提供 Codex 版本、记录类型、聚合计数和合成复现。使用贡献指南的 sanitize-fixture 流程，并在分享前手动检查。
